name: Autuskey Jewelry Manager
author: Autuskey

sections.description:
The Autuskey Jewelry Manager plugin is designed specifically for jewelry stores using WooCommerce. It provides comprehensive tools to manage jewelry products with detailed specifications including metal types, purity levels, weight calculations, making charges, stone information, and certification details.

Key Features

Metal Type & Purity Management
* Configurable metal types (Gold, Silver, Platinum, Palladium)
* Purity level selection (18K, 22K, 24K for Gold, 925/999 for Silver, etc.)
* Easy dropdown selection interface

Weight Management
* Gross Weight input field
* Stone Weight input field
* Automatic Net Metal Weight calculation
* All weights displayed on product pages

Making Charges
* Fixed amount or percentage-based making charges
* Automatic price calculation including making charges
* Clear price breakdown display for customers

Stone Information
* Toggle for products with stones
* Stone type specification
* Stone weight tracking
* Display stone details on product pages

Certification & Hallmarking
* Certification/Hallmark checkbox
* Certificate upload functionality (images or PDFs)
* Certification badge display on product pages
* Download link for certificates

Frontend Display
* Beautiful product detail section
* Clear specification grid layout
* Price breakdown with making charges
* Certification badges and download links
* Mobile-responsive design

Cart & Checkout Integration
* Jewelry specifications in cart
* Complete product details in order emails
* Order details include all jewelry information
* Proper meta data handling

Perfect for:

  • Jewelry stores
  • Gold/Silver retailers
  • Custom jewelry makers
  • Precious metal dealers
  • Certified jewelry sellers

Technical Requirements

  • WordPress 6.5 or higher
  • WooCommerce 6.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher

Support

For support, updates, or feature requests, please visit Autuskey Support.

Privacy Policy

This plugin does not collect any personal data from your website visitors. All jewelry information is stored locally in your WordPress database as product metadata.

Credits

Developed by Autuskey – https://autuskey.com
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/autuskey-jewelry-manager directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and activated.
  4. Go to WooCommerce > Jewelry Manager to configure your settings.
  5. Start adding jewelry details to your products in the product edit screen.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes, this plugin is specifically designed for WooCommerce and requires WooCommerce to be installed and activated.

Can I customize the metal types and purity options?

Yes, you can fully customize metal types and their purity options from the plugin settings page under WooCommerce > Jewelry Manager.

How are making charges calculated?

Making charges can be calculated as either a fixed amount or as a percentage of the base product price. You can set this individually for each product or use default values.

Can customers download certificates?

Yes, if you upload a certificate for a product and mark it as certified, customers will see a certification badge and a download link on the product page.

Is the plugin mobile-friendly?

Yes, all frontend displays are fully responsive and mobile-friendly.

Can I bulk edit jewelry information?

Currently, jewelry information needs to be added individually to each product. Bulk editing features may be added in future versions.
